status: First scoped rendering/runtime batch; remaining roadmap and Figma parity are NOT complete

roadmapProgress.B01: partial: optical representation corpus and real-document cross-host controls; 60 independent SVG/text/geometry/coverage external inputs not complete
roadmapProgress.B02: partial: five-round WASM compile and Electron work/acknowledgement timing; transport/upload counters; full stage/scale matrix still pending
roadmapProgress.D01: partial: complete-pose publication, cancellation cleanup and working-budget retry preserving old textures; full readiness state matrix pending
roadmapProgress.R1-R7: other schema, Unicode, SVG, new coverage/compute feature work remains pending

changes: Separate exact desktop arithmetic from resident SDR transport and CPU preparation. Ordinary canvas uses the local WebGPU device, not native-sidecar frame IPC.

Non-coherent RGBA32F resident work uses the same existing dynamic viewport allowance in both arithmetic modes. Working pool can start at 512 MiB and remains capped by the existing 1 GiB policy; display/interactions/geometry are separately budgeted. This is not a free-VRAM query.
Exact whole-viewport packets use the existing 8,000,000 f32 aggregate allowance (32,000,000 bytes); per-path/scan-work limits remain unchanged.
Canonical world-coordinate capture and output-relative halo/pose bounds retain the settled computation lattice. HQ resolve stays on its exact tiled path with no unconverted interaction-window crop.

Allocation pressure retires failed commands/scratch while retaining the live display device. Tiled replacements publish atomically; incomplete groups are released. A rare split may assemble bitmaps, without lowering density.
Desktop build defaults to release and builds backend/GPU utility in one Cargo graph. Native GPU inputs are included in build provenance.
Frame/section titles now select and drag through the ordinary interaction path, enforcing page membership, inherited locks/visibility and existing Shift intent.
Shared Web/Electron check bundles, bounded private reports, raster transport counters and field-upload attribution were added.
precision: No LUT approximation, density reduction at normal zoom, relaxed SIMD/fast-math switch or software_raster rewrite. Internal before/after and current-pose/fresh-frame gates are separate from Figma comparison.

fixture.note: Real imported UI kit; synthetic dependency overlay moves board 14 above board 21 with glass/background blur and multiply.

electronPerformance.comparison: Exact tiled recovery versus exact same-device resident capture, not the original failing desktop path
electronPerformance.scope: Same 19949-node document, glass + multiply + overlapping real boards, 1000x640 CSS, DPR 2, zoom 0.6. No pixel oracle/readbacks during performance rounds.
electronPerformance.note: Five fresh Electron profiles per variant. 37 costly fixed poses rather than the plan's general 100 samples. Timing is render work and submission acknowledgement, not input-to-photon. Initial warm includes viewport coverage and interaction preparation.

performanceBoundary: The measured speedup includes restoring the existing resident working-memory allowance (256 -> 512 MiB on this viewport). It is not an equal-memory algorithm comparison. Larger residency is the tradeoff; results are render work/submission acknowledgement, not input-to-photon or proof of 60 FPS.

externalFigma.reference: Pinned Figma PNGs from earlier 2026-10-18 capture, unchanged; original frame IDs/names/positions re-read via Figma this turn, no new reference export claimed
externalFigma.result: NOT equal: approximately 13.6–15.4% differing pixels for desktop reference poses. Existing import/text/effect differences still require attribution and repair. Internal optimization equality is not Figma parity.

buildDecisions.simd: Remains opt-in: five rounds show load median reduction but no >=20% stable compile/end-to-end target benefit; hot compile is slightly slower.
buildDecisions.wasmOpt: Binaryen 133 installed; isolated -O2 SIMD artifact passed scalar/SIMD output checks. Not default.

wasmBenchmark.note: Fresh Engine per round, loaded modules shared. moduleMs is one sample, not a cold-start distribution. No GPU/present or page latency is measured.

buildDecisions.pngParallelAndEnginePool: Deferred: current PNG endpoint is a distinct band renderer, and a full Engine pool needs request/resource-isolation and memory/concurrency proof. Default Fonts sharing was delivered in the initial commit.
buildDecisions.coherentSparseGlass: Opt-in VITE_DESIGN_COHERENT_SPARSE_GLASS=1 only. Real desktop round improved about 11%, below adoption target; one pinned WebGL2 full-suite mismatch was not reproduced in isolated and complete reruns. Failure is retained, not dismissed.

desktop.pan: 50 by 20 screenshot pixels; content and outline moved together; authored position unchanged

limits: UI snapshots confirm completed interactions, not intermediate physical input-to-photon timing.
A native AX setValue on the name field did not commit; regular select-all/paste did.
Portable Save As was verified separately from automatic local workspace persistence.

retainedFailures: Original exact Electron interaction hit aggregate packet admission, then working-surface limits; first corrected tiled variant was functional but ~0.9 s/update.
First tiled coordinate experiment differed in two RGBA bytes at one pose; canonical computation camera fixed it. All four before/after poses are zero difference.
A speculative eager HQ tiling condition was not exercised by the analytic real fixture and was removed; it is not counted as a measured optimization.
Seven full-suite tests timed out when run alongside builds with unrestricted worker count; two-worker rerun passed without increasing timeouts.
Early optical probe used an inadmissible managed analytic profile; corrected to admitted profiles. Analytic/managed remains explicitly unsupported.
A 600x480 HQ WebGL2 optical input exceeded its existing working budget; retained as a resource-limit failure, not silently downsampled.
One optical WebGL2 case timed out during concurrent construction; isolated validation reran with test-window occlusion throttling disabled. Cause is not asserted.
One pinned WebGL2 figma/rotate/radius=0 run differed by up to 7 RGBA values; isolated and full reruns passed. Intermittency remains an experimental validation gap.
remaining: Cold zoom retains content but can still display old-density pixels: normal-zoom sharp-content coverage temporarily reached zero in both hosts. No claim of blur-free cold zoom.
Complex glass p95 is still ~374 ms pooled, far above 33.3/16.7 ms. CPU graph/GPU waits dominate remaining work; inspect repeated exact blending/coverage work before blindly enabling SIMD.
Initial document/viewport/interaction preparation still takes seconds and has outliers; no instant cold-import claim.
Full Figma effect/import/text/layout parity is not achieved; external reference differences remain.
R0 external 60-input corpus and remainder of R1–R7 roadmap, PNG parallel export and full Engine pool remain incomplete.
HDR and other OS/hardware families were not validated.
